# MKTMP

<!-- ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ -->

## SYNOPSIS

    mktmp <ARGUMENT>...

<!-- ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ -->

## DESCRIPTION

The command 'mktmp' is a wrapper for functionality provided by 'libpath.sh',
offering a portable, POSIX-compliant alternative to 'mktemp(1)'.

[Documentation for `libpath.sh` applies](./libpath.md) (and is not
replicated here).
